# Codesters

> Codesters is a comprehensive Python coding platform and curriculum solution designed for K-12 classrooms, combining interactive lessons, project-based learning, and professional development for educators.

Codesters provides a complete ecosystem for teaching Python programming through structured curricula, a drag-to-text code editor, and student project exploration. The platform emphasizes game design, data science, and cybersecurity applications to engage learners at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- K-12 coding education
- Project-based learning
- Game design
- Data science
- Cybersecurity
- Code editor
- Curriculum pathways
- Student projects
- Teacher professional development
- Beginner programming
- Functions and events
- Graphics and visualization
- Learning management system
- Educational platform

## Getting Started

- [Codesters: Coding in your Classroom](https://www.codesters.com): Codesters homepage: complete Python coding solution for K-12 classrooms
- [Getting Started with Codesters](https://www.codesters.com/get-started): Quick start guide for teachers to implement Codesters in classrooms
- [Codesters Python Coding Platform](https://www.codesters.com/coding-platform): Codesters online Python editor with drag-to-text and interactive output

## Core Curricula

- [Intro to Codesters](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/intro-to-codesters-2018): Intro to Codesters curriculum pathway for beginner Python learners
- [Python - Part 1](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/python-1-v2): Python - Part 1 curriculum covering foundational programming concepts
- [Python - Part 2](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/python-2-v2): Python - Part 2 curriculum with functions, events, and game design
- [Python - Part 3](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/python-3): Python - Part 3 advanced curriculum for intermediate programmers

## Capstone Pathways

- [Python with Graphics](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/python-with-graphics): Graphics capstone pathway teaching Python with visual design projects
- [Python with Data](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/python-with-data): Data science capstone pathway combining Python with data analysis
- [Python with Functions](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/python-with-functions): Functions capstone pathway for advanced Python programming concepts
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity curriculum pathway using Python programming concepts

## Projects & Exploration

- [Codesters Project Editor](https://www.codesters.com/project): Codesters project editor for creating and managing student code projects
- [Codesters Explore](https://www.codesters.com/explore): Browse hundreds of Python games and animations created in Codesters

## Teacher Resources

- [Codesters Professional Development](https://www.codesters.com/professional-development): Remote PD workshops training teachers to teach Python effectively
- [Building your First Program](https://www.codesters.com/curriculum/intro-to-codesters-2018/Building+your+First+Program/1): Interactive lesson on building first Python program in Codesters
